title: Installer multimodal supported-mode wizard

context.summary: Add installer wizard support for the v0.1.1 multimodal supported preset.
context.background: Once the promoted runners exist, the installer needs a clear supported-mode path with resource preflight, retries, rollback and logs.

in: Add supported multimodal preset prompts and answer-file fields.
Allow per-role enablement and runner selection with resource confirmation.
Install selected runners, retry downloads/pulls, rollback failed installation steps and write diagnostics.
Require successful runner health checks before reporting selected functions ready.

acceptance_criteria: Wizard can configure a supported multimodal preset from an answer file and interactive prompts.
Resource preflight is shown for every selected heavy runner.
Failed runner startup rolls back Mindory-created installation state.
Healthchecked selected functions are reflected in generated config and redacted summary.

manual_checks: Run the installer dry-run with the supported multimodal answer file.
Run one live install with selected local runners on Docker.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
